purpose: Oráculo independiente QA para las dos bases demostrativas autorizadas; SQL de referencia específico de datos de ensayo, no lógica runtime ni configuración del producto.
operation: Lectura SQL Server con las conexiones activas registradas en la aplicación; sin LLM, ETL, cambios de configuración ni filas individuales en la salida.
precision: Importes decimales serializados como texto para conservar precisión; conteos y cantidades como enteros.

cases.business_scope: Todas las líneas registradas en SalesOrderDetail; importe LineTotal sin reinterpretar su significado fiscal.
cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS line_count,
SUM(CAST(d.[OrderQty] AS bigint)) AS total_units,
COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT d.[SalesOrderID]) AS distinct_documents,
SUM(d.[LineTotal]) AS recorded_amount
FROM [Sales].[SalesOrderDetail] AS d

cases.business_scope: Año 2013 por fecha de pedido y territorio comercial Northwest de la cabecera de pedido.
cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS line_count,
SUM(CAST(d.[OrderQty] AS bigint)) AS total_units,
COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT d.[SalesOrderID]) AS distinct_documents,
SUM(d.[LineTotal]) AS recorded_amount
FROM [Sales].[SalesOrderDetail] AS d
JOIN [Sales].[SalesOrderHeader] AS h ON d.[SalesOrderID] = h.[SalesOrderID]
JOIN [Sales].[SalesTerritory] AS t ON h.[TerritoryID] = t.[TerritoryID]
WHERE h.[OrderDate] >= ? AND h.[OrderDate] < ? AND t.[Name] = ?

cases.business_scope: Todas las líneas de factura; importe ExtendedPrice en moneda de origen sin atribuir moneda ISO ni composición fiscal no demostrada.
cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS line_count,
SUM(CAST(l.[Quantity] AS bigint)) AS total_units,
COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT l.[InvoiceID]) AS distinct_documents,
SUM(l.[ExtendedPrice]) AS recorded_amount
FROM [Sales].[InvoiceLines] AS l

cases.business_scope: Año 2015 por InvoiceDate y provincia California de la ciudad de entrega del cliente facturado. La dirección actual no prueba la ubicación histórica de la entrega.
cases.sql:
SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS line_count,
SUM(CAST(l.[Quantity] AS bigint)) AS total_units,
COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT l.[InvoiceID]) AS distinct_documents,
SUM(l.[ExtendedPrice]) AS recorded_amount
FROM [Sales].[InvoiceLines] AS l
JOIN [Sales].[Invoices] AS i ON l.[InvoiceID] = i.[InvoiceID]
JOIN [Sales].[Customers] AS c ON i.[CustomerID] = c.[CustomerID]
JOIN [Application].[Cities] AS city ON c.[DeliveryCityID] = city.[CityID]
JOIN [Application].[StateProvinces] AS sp ON city.[StateProvinceID] = sp.[StateProvinceID]
WHERE i.[InvoiceDate] >= ? AND i.[InvoiceDate] < ? AND sp.[StateProvinceName] = ?
